mapper.sql: select id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, map_type, upstream_key, upstream_variant, target_id, target_code, status, remark, creator, create_time, update_time from crm_gateway_pull_map
mapper.insert: insert into crm_gateway_pull_map ( supplier_id, supplier_account_id, map_type, upstream_key, upstream_variant, target_id, target_code, status, remark, creator, create_time ) values ( #{supplierId}, ifnull(#{supplierAccountId}, 0), #{mapType}, ifnull(#{upstreamKey}, ''), ifnull(#{upstreamVariant}, ''), #{targetId}, #{targetCode}, ifnull(#{status}, 1), #{remark}, #{creator}, ifnull(#{createTime}, sysdate()) )
